title: polystichum bissetianum
intro: Polystichum bissetianum, commonly known as the Bisset's fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum bissetianum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These constituents may contribute to the plant's ability to protect against cell damage, modulate the immune system, and exhibit anti-cancer properties.
